description: Projects and technical notes on AI infrastructure, hardware/software co-design, high-performance computing, embedded systems, biomedical sensing front ends, robotics, and medical AI.
intro: I am a final-year BEng student in Microelectronic Science and Engineering at Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University and the University of Liverpool (dual degree, Sep 2023 – Jul 2027). I hold First Class averages in Years 1–2 and rank 9/91 in the programme cohort (top 10%). My interests include AI infrastructure, hardware/software co-design, high-performance computing, embedded systems and biomedical sensing front ends. This site collects my projects, research and technical notes.
about: I use coding agents during development and keep each project's problem definition, architecture, experiments and validation open to inspection. My current work spans AI infrastructure, hardware/software co-design, high-performance computing, embedded systems, biomedical sensing front ends, connectome-driven robotics and medical imaging AI.
